transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Well... I'm here because I feel like I’m just coming apart at the seams lately. 

We started getting these foreclosure notices in the mail, and ever since then, I just can't seem to function right. I catch myself sitting out in my truck crying before I even clock in for work. I jump every single time my phone rings. And it's really affecting my job, too. I'm snapping at the apprentices, and I keep making these stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never, ever would’ve made before. 

I just don't know how to handle it all right now.
Can you tell me if these feelings of being overwhelmed and anxious started before the foreclosure notices began, or have they mostly been since that started happening?

It was definitely after. I was functioning completely normally before all this. But then the letters and the phone calls started coming in... and I'd say within a few weeks of getting that first formal notice, everything just started falling apart. That's when my work and my home life really started unraveling.
Since the foreclosure notices started, have you found yourself constantly thinking about them, trying to avoid anything related, or feeling like you're on edge all the time?

I'm definitely on edge. Like I mentioned, just hearing my phone ring makes me jump. But... as far as constantly thinking about the notices or trying to avoid things? I don't really think so. I haven't noticed myself doing that. I just feel completely overwhelmed by the whole situation.
Since this started, have you found yourself having upsetting thoughts or memories about the foreclosure situation that keep coming up, even when you don't want them to?

No, I haven't really had that. I mean... obviously I think about the house and the money because it's a real problem I have to figure out. But it's not like... I don't get these random memories or thoughts popping into my head when I don't want them to. It's just the constant, heavy stress of the actual situation that's wearing me down.
Have you been avoiding any specific places, people, or activities because they remind you of the foreclosure situation?

No, not really. I mean, I still go to work at the shop every day, and I still talk to my friends and family. I'm not hiding from anyone or staying away from anywhere specific. It's just... the whole thing is just hanging over my head all the time. But I'm not avoiding things because of it.
